environment.description: Elevated Windows terminal at the repository root; no provider credentials exported.

proposed_commands.why: Shows the exact revision the cut is about.
Proves the pinned runtime resolves to the recorded provenance.

notes: DRAFT: this file describes no executable capture. A human must set status to APPROVED, fill every preflight flag, record checked_by/checked_at, move the approved entries into captures, and sign approved_by/approved_at.
Capture runs in its own visible console; the recording is bounded to that window and abandoned if the window moves.
Raw recordings stay under work/raw and are never distributed; only a redacted derivative with a RedactionReceipt may be used by a cut.
